snippet.title: Presidential Rise | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Presidential Rise now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926700/Presidential_Rise/ 

Presidential Rise is a strategy management game where you lead a growing nation. Plan policies, manage the economy, respond to public needs, and face political dilemmas. Your leadership shapes the nation's success or its downfall.
